title: VivaVideo - Video Cut & Editor
summary: AI Video Editor: AI Templates, Text to Video, Extract Audio, Auto Caption.
description:
VivaVideo: Your free AI creative partner to turn imagination into influence. More intuitive for beginners, more powerful for pros.

Generate AI videos, create one-tap Reels, and edit like a pro — all in one app. Share stories that grow your audience across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and beyond.

FREE & No Ads!

Powerful AI Video Tools
- Track moving objects with Smart Tracking to create dynamic, professional shots.
- Sync video highlights with AI Beat for perfectly timed edits.
- Generate AI Auto Captions — speech-to-text & translation in one tap.
- Create AI Avatars: turn text into talking clips with voice customization. Powered by Veo 3 AI.
- Generate custom AI Music based on your ideas or lyrics.
- Clone your voice with AI Voice Clone — add customized emotions in any language.
- Animate your photos with AI hug, AI kiss, and AI muscle effects (Image to Video).
- Remove backgrounds or isolate objects with AI Cutout — smart strokes, instant results.
- Enhance videos with advanced Slow-Motion for cinematic smoothness.

User-friendly Video Editing for Beginners
- Trim, cut, split, or merge video clips without losing quality.
- Control speed with customizable & pre-set speed curves.
- Add smooth transitions and visual effects.
- Customize text styles & fonts for titles and captions.
- Add fun stickers & emojis to bring personality.
- Adjust brightness, contrast & saturation for better visuals.

Full-featured Video Editing for Professionals
- Create smooth animations with Keyframe editing.
- Apply slow-motion effects to specific video parts.
- Eliminate colors with Chromakey effects for immersive scenes.
- Add multiple layers with Picture-in-Picture (PIP): video, images, stickers, effects, text.
- Cover and mix video clips with Masking for unique effects.
- Blur or pixelate sensitive areas with Mosaic.
- Track moving objects for precise effects, text, or animations to follow their motion.

Special Features
- Generate Auto Captions & Caption Translation — AI speech-to-text and one-tap subtitle translation.
- Remove backgrounds and change video background instantly.

Trending Effects & Filters
- Apply various effects: Glitch, Fade, Weather, Retro DV, Blur, 3D.
- Enhance videos with cinematic filters & color adjustments.

Music & Sound Effects
- Elevate videos with a vast library of music clips and sound effects.
- Extract audio from video clips and recordings.

With VivaVideo — your all-in-one AI video editor & video maker with music — you can easily craft eye-catching content. Whether you're a beginner or pro, generate, edit, and share high-quality videos in minutes!
developer: QuVideo Inc. Video Editor & Video Maker App
